hypotheses.reasoning: notification-svc's heap grows without being freed. After full GC, usage was 78% at 20:49:18 and 87% at 20:52:45, with old gen not reclaimed. It then hit OutOfMemoryError in messageCache.put and was OOMKilled at the 2Gi limit (20:53:24). The cycle repeated at 20:56:45 and 20:59:10 ('heap exhausted while growing messageCache'). Each restart comes back as the same v1.21.3 and warms the cache again, so the 502 bursts at the gateway ('no healthy upstream', connection reset) follow the crash/restart cycles. No deploy happened in the window. template-svc stayed healthy (renders under 100ms, apart from one 2975ms render call logged by notification-svc at 20:44:37). The catalog-svc translation 401s only affect GET /search, not /notify, and the legacy-inventory healthcheck timeouts are noise from a deprecated endpoint.
A separate, concurrent fault: catalog-svc's translation API key is rejected (401). This causes the 502s on /search via search-api and web-bff, but not the POST /v1/notify alert.

verdict.recommendedAction: Find and fix the unbounded growth of messageCache in notification-svc: add a size limit or eviction, and take heap dumps to confirm. In the meantime, raise the memory limit or restart pods ahead of the crashes, and check whether the cache warm-up on startup speeds up the next OOM. Separately, rotate or fix the catalog-svc translation API key.
